facts.activity_file: making up, decanting and dosing reagents

control_failures.control_label: selection, fit testing and maintenance of respirators

facts.hazard_release: fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation
facts.title: audit finding - work clearance records incomplete for P-8303

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control RESPIRATORY_PROTECTION_PROGRAM: the selection, fit testing and maintenance of respirators was in place but did not perform, and the accident investigation classified this as an individual or team action.

recommendations: Confirm at the next spot check that the selection, fit testing and maintenance of respirators on P-8303, M-8303 and TK-8311 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in handling and dosing reagents, specifically making up, decanting and dosing reagents. P-8303 (reagent dosing pumps) is in service for reagent make-up and dosing. The task proceeded during shift handover while the selection, fit testing and maintenance of respirators was in place but did not perform. The chemical energy involved is held as hydrocarbon, and the recorded presentation was fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation.
response.summary: On 11 November 2006 a planned spot check of P-8303, M-8303 and TK-8311 at Tolgarra Processing and Power Station found the selection, fit testing and maintenance of respirators not effective.
